flood.label: Flooding
safety_steps: Move to the highest floor you can reach safely.
Stay away from electrical switches, sockets and wet wiring.
Do not walk or drive through moving floodwater.
questions: Where are you? Send your location pin, or tell me the nearest landmark.
Is anyone with you unable to move on their own?

fire.label: Fire
safety_steps: Get out of the building now if you can, and stay out.
Stay low where there is smoke.
questions: Where are you? Send your location pin, or tell me the nearest landmark.
Is everyone out of the building?

medical.label: Medical emergency
safety_steps: Call the ambulance number above first.
Stay with the person and keep them still.
Keep the route to them clear so help can reach you.
questions: Where are you? Send your location pin, or tell me the nearest landmark.
Is the person conscious and breathing?

trapped.label: Trapped or stranded
safety_steps: Stay where you are if moving is unsafe.
Make yourself visible from outside if you can.
Save your phone battery; send short messages.
questions: Where are you? Send your location pin, or tell me the nearest landmark.
How many people are with you?

structural.label: Building damage
safety_steps: Leave the building if you can do so safely.
Stay clear of damaged walls, ceilings and balconies.
Do not re-enter to collect belongings.
questions: Where are you? Send your location pin, or tell me the nearest landmark.

other.label: Emergency
safety_steps: Move somewhere safe if you can.
Stay where you can be reached by phone.
questions: Where are you? Send your location pin, or tell me the nearest landmark.
What do you need most right now?
